one_line_thesis: Swedish industrial serial acquirer of niche subsidiaries — decentralized Pabrai-style model with 2025–2026 margin/FCF turnaround underway; organic sales still negative while unprofitable units are pruned.

deep_dive.executive_summary: Teqnion is a proven decentralized serial acquirer with a strengthening margin story: FY2025 net sales +15% (nine acquisitions), EBITA +36%, organic -5% from deliberate exits, and equity ratio 42.8%. Goodwill impairment 73 MSEK (Q3 2025) flags past overpayment risk. Universal contract proofs value the operating stack at roughly 142 SEK per share versus ~163 SEK spot. Lawrence base expected annual return is 17.54% on 10.08 SEK FY2025 FCF per share; total synthesis 17.54% includes context-tier weights. Durable competitive advantage (Munger moat) is stable at the portfolio level; asymmetric pay...

pricing_analysis.conclusion: Hurdle prices are derived from the decision-grade universal contract; they do not constitute a capital decision.

decision.next_action: Complete isolated rater outputs, proposer case, pre-mortem, and research response without sharing peer votes.

industry.structure: Fragmented European niche-industrial suppliers; Teqnion aggregates local leaders through decentralized ownership with parent-level capital allocation.

industry.trend: Margin inflection (EBITA 11.3% FY2025, Q1 2026 14.3% per prior interim) and FCF recovery; UK build-out and earn-out liabilities increase balance-sheet complexity.
